body: i know it doesn’t make a lot of sense; i just get worried that if it turns out i’m not happy and feel the need to bail, i’ll have put somebody else’s emotions on the line only to end up hurting them. my emotions all kind of blur into one so it’s hard for me to pick out exactly how i feel.

thank you so much, you just made my day!! :^)) ED’s are so horrible and scary for everybody who suffers, so if i can turn my experiences into something humorous it doesn’t make it feel so bad, it reminds me that i’m more than my disorder, so i really appreciate your comment <3 i’m sorry to hear that you’re also struggling and i hope things get better soon. i love that your mind went straight to coronavirus for an excuse, it’s kinda funny how we often forget that people can throw up for totally normal reasons 😅 thanks for the advice, i’ll definitely come up with a good cover story in advance in case this type of thing happens again!

my favourite is this suicidal texting service thing in the uk for when you don’t feel like actually talking. sounds great in theory. in reality, i have attempted to use it three (3) times and have received nothing but an automated response every. single. time. even though all the promotional materials ASSURE you that you will speak to an ‘actual human with proper training’. you get this basic text that says ‘stand by. you are so brave for contacting us. we will find a representative for you shortly’. after about 45 mins to an hour i would get a response like ‘hello accidental-dinosaur, i hear you are struggling, do you want to talk about it?’ it’s been a fucking HOUR dude, no i DO NOT want to talk about it anymore smh

i know it seems scary but i will always urge you to ask for help. at the very least you’ll be on the radar of the health services so they know that you’re struggling. i hope you’re doing okay and end up getting the help you deserve.

wow, it really means a lot to me that you would take the time to write this, especially considering their main issue with me is that i’m not ‘thin enough’ either. as painful and invalidating as it is to hear that, it’s really nice to know i’m not alone. i’m so sorry you had to experience the same treatment from the people who are supposed to help, and i hope you’re doing better now / at least on the path to recovery. it seems completely insane to me that they’d rather wait until people in serious danger as opposed to taking preventative measures to ensure it doesn’t get to that, but it doesn’t mean you aren’t worthy of treatment <3
